name: Deemed Rate Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of a deemed rate.

DEDI.name: Deemed Dividend Proceeds
DEDI.definition: Deemed rate of dividend proceeds attributed to the security holder.

DEFP.name: Deemed Fund Proceeds
DEFP.definition: Deemed rate of fund proceeds attributed to the security holder.

DEIT.name: Deemed Interest Proceeds
DEIT.definition: Deemed rate of interest proceeds attributed to the security holder.

DERY.name: Deemed Royalties Proceeds
DERY.definition: Deemed rate of royalties proceeds attributed to the security holder.
